title: The Utter Corruption of God's People

questions.question: "Run to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, look and take note! Search her squares to see if you can find a man, one who does justice and seeks..., that I may pardon her."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:1 (ESV): "to see if you can find a man, one who does justice and seeks truth, that I may pardon her."

questions.question: "O Lord, do not your eyes look for truth? You have struck them down, but they felt no anguish; you have consumed them, but they refused to take..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:3 (ESV): "you have consumed them, but they refused to take correction."

questions.question: Jeremiah decided he would go to whom, because they presumably knew the way of the Lord and the justice of their God?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:5 (ESV): "I will go to the great and will speak to them, for they know the way of the Lord, the justice of their God."

questions.question: "Therefore a... from the forest shall strike them down; a... from the desert shall devastate them. A leopard is watching their cities;"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:6 (ESV): "Therefore a lion from the forest shall strike them down; a wolf from the desert shall devastate them."

questions.question: "How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me and have sworn by those who are no gods. When I... them, they committed adultery and trooped to the houses of whores."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:7 (ESV): "When I fed them to the full, they committed adultery and trooped to the houses of whores."

questions.question: "Shall I not punish them for these things? declares the Lord; and shall I not avenge myself on a nation such as this? Go up through her vine rows and destroy, but make not a... end;"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:9-10 (ESV): "Go up through her vine rows and destroy, but make not a full end;"

questions.question: "They have spoken falsely of the Lord and have said, 'He will do nothing; no disaster will come upon us, nor shall we see... or famine.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:12 (ESV): "nor shall we see sword or famine."

questions.question: "The prophets will become..., the word is not in them. Thus shall it be done to them!"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:13 (ESV): "The prophets will become wind; the word is not in them."

questions.question: "Therefore thus says the Lord, the God of hosts: Because you have spoken this word, behold, I am making my words in your mouth..., and this people wood, and the... shall consume them."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:14 (ESV): "behold, I am making my words in your mouth a fire, and this people wood, and the fire shall consume them."

questions.question: "Behold, I am bringing against you a nation from afar, O house of Israel, declares the Lord. It is an enduring nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose... you do not know,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:15 (ESV): "a nation whose language you do not know, nor can you understand what they say."

questions.question: "Their quiver is like an open tomb; they are all..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:16 (ESV): "Their quiver is like an open tomb; they are all mighty warriors."

questions.question: "Hear this, O foolish and senseless people, who have eyes, but see not, who have..., but hear not."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:21 (ESV): "who have eyes, but see not, who have ears, but hear not."

questions.question: "Do you not fear me? declares the Lord... I placed the... as a boundary for the sea, a perpetual barrier that it cannot pass;"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:22 (ESV): "I placed the sand as a boundary for the sea, a perpetual barrier that it cannot pass;"

questions.question: "They do not say in their hearts, 'Let us fear the Lord our God, who gives the rain in its season, the autumn rain and the spring rain, and keeps for us the weeks appointed for the...'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:24 (ESV): "and keeps for us the weeks appointed for the harvest."

questions.question: "An appalling and horrible thing has happened in the land: the prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule at their direction; my people... it so, but what will you do when the end comes?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 5:30-31 (ESV): "my people love to have it so, but what will you do when the end comes?"

key_verse_text: "Run to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, look and take note! Search her squares to see if you can find a man, one who does justice and seeks truth, that I may pardon her."
